policy: Author general recommendations take priority; otherwise fresh checkpoint defaults plus installed Transformers defaults. Usage-example choices are not universal recommendations. No pipeline or mutated model.generation_config is inherited.
output_budget_policy: Preserve all original task/stage max_new_tokens upper bounds. Existing complete-input remaining-context cap remains in force.
seed_policy: Existing per-sample/per-stage audit seeds unchanged; seed is an experiment reproducibility control, not a sampling recommendation.
identity_boundary: Pinned public source revisions establish recommendations only. Local weight revision/identity is not inferred; local config hashes are recorded at future runtime.
